Class RoleClientImpl

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.core.client.ClientBase
com.eqixiac.equinix.iam.client.internal.implementation.RoleClientImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
RoleClient
public class RoleClientImpl extends ClientBase implements RoleClient
Internal client implementation for the IAM roles catalog. The role responses are read-only and use opaque-token (nextPageToken) pagination rather than the core's offset-based paging, so the deserialized RoleList (carrying list + nextPageToken) is returned directly; callers fetch subsequent pages by passing getNextPageToken() back as the pageToken argument.
